# 🔐 Security Audit Template

## Audit scope
- Repository commit:
- PBIX / XLSX versions:
- Auditor / date:
- Included environments:

## Checklist
- [ ] Workbook classification and redistribution rights reviewed.
- [ ] PBIX source credentials and parameters inspected.
- [ ] Screenshots and exports checked for sensitive data.
- [ ] GitHub Actions permissions reviewed.
- [ ] Third-party workflow actions reviewed.
- [ ] Repository access and branch settings reviewed.
- [ ] Power BI Service permissions reviewed, if used.
- [ ] Private vulnerability reporting route confirmed.

## Findings
| ID | Severity | Asset | Finding | Evidence | Recommendation | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Conclusion
State what was audited, what was not audited, unresolved risks, and retest date. Do not claim certification.
